items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: was Black Benny, Red Happy, and Kimball, trumpet player.

ctx.x: You remember who was in Robichaux's band at the Liried?
No, the only two I remember was Black, three rather, was Black Benny, Red Happy, and Kimball, trumpet player. I mean he was their trumpet player too, believe me.
Well who came first, Black Benny or Red Happy?
No. Did you ever hear a few of the other drummers I'll ask you about, like Old Man Cottrell, we were talking about his stuff earlier?

Well, yeah, yeah, I heard Old Man Cottrell, I see him every week at the Old Lyric Theatre, because he was playing out there with the, not the, not the, but the, Kimball, a trumpet player. Mm-hmm. Well, he used to play out there with them when they was having vaudeville out there. At the Lyric. At the Old Lyric Theatre, yeah. And, uh, what, Black Benny?
Well, tell me something more about Black Benny, because I never got to hear him or see him. I don't know.
